capture._comment: Needs Borderless or Windowed mode, same as CS2.

_events_comment: Classes taken from a live audio_test.py probe. Background music sits high in most windows but does not mask these, since YAMNet scores each class independently.

ANIMAL.description: A farm animal made a sound

PICKUP.description: An item was picked up or used

CHOP.description: A tool struck something (chopping, mining, digging)

_scene_prompts_comment: Prompts avoid describing anything permanently on screen. An earlier 'grid of item slots' prompt matched the hotbar and the tiled soil, so it fired constantly.
